name: Spinel Charo Floria
original_name: スピネル・チャロ・フロウリア
source:
Prince of the 'Flower Country Floria'.
He was chosen to pour power into the 'magic stone'.
A graceful and refined guy who finds anything fun.
He loves showy and lively things, beautiful things like women and jewels.
He always worries about the little brother of a dead friend of his, [url=/c46514]Triffle[/url], though he's always picking on him.
